steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each requisition is placed by its stage and the time spent there.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 offer has had no decision for 10 days

findings.title: Offer with no decision after 10 days
Candidate more than 14 days in one stage
findings.fix: Move the candidate on or close the stage

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] req-ops-03.md:12  Offer with no decision after 10 days.
       Fix: Chase the decision today.
[medium] req-eng-14.md:19  Candidate more than 14 days in one stage.
       Fix: Move the candidate on or close the stage.
[low] req-legal-02.md:26  Requisition with no candidates.
       Fix: Review the sourcing plan.
Not checked: Candidate quality.
pros: Checks a candidate with more than 14 days in one stage, an offer with no decision after 10 days, and a requisition with no candidates.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-hiring-pipeline skill on the records for this review.
